name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Anata ni Chikau Ai
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを　あなたに誓う愛
source:
Shizuku and her girlfriend Eris enjoyed their vacation with the other Best Couples from St. Michael’s…

But after getting tangled up with Rena, who still has some summer vacation left, they’ve lingered on the tropical island.

However, Eris continues to be a hit with the ladies, and Shizuku is feeling a little let down.  But when she decides to consult with Rena about her anxiety…

[Translated from [url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/2014/05/18/kiss-petals-sworn-love/]Petals' Garden[/url]]
translation:
雫和女友艾莉丝与圣米迦勒学院的其他最佳情侣们一起享受了假期……

但在与暑假还没结束的怜奈纠缠之后，她们继续留在热带岛屿上。

然而，艾莉丝依然很受女性欢迎，雫感到有些失落。当她决定向怜奈咨询自己的不安时……

[译自[url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/2014/05/18/kiss-petals-sworn-love/]Petals' Garden[/url]]
